intro.title: Search syntax
intro.description: Start with a card name. Add a few commands to narrow your search by color, type, printing, format and more.

quickStart.title: From a name to a focused search

name.title: Enter a card name or part of one.
name.body: Results appear as you type after a short pause. A name is required, even when using filters.

reference.title: Every supported filter
reference.description: Add these command snippets to a card name. Choose a command below to jump to its examples and value rules.

combining.title: Combine and repeat commands
combining.description: Add different commands to narrow several properties in the same search. Repeat a command to supply multiple values; the later value does not erase the earlier one.
combining.angel: Search the name Angel with creature type, flying and mana value 4.
combining.lotus: Search the name Lotus with a set code and collector number.
combining.elfBefore: Supply green or black as alternatives. For both colors in one filter, use
combining.dragon: Supply two rarity values while searching the name Dragon.
combining.note: Filters stay with you when moving between the home and header search boxes. Delete a command to remove that filter, or remove all commands to return to a name-only search.

noResults.body: Check the name, remove filters one at a time, and look for commands left over from a previous search. Valid syntax can still produce no matches. The examples illustrate syntax and do not guarantee results.

searchFailed.term: “Unable to search cards. Please try again.”
searchFailed.body: The search request could not be completed. Try again; this message is separate from a syntax error or an empty result list.

type.description: Filter by card type, supertype or subtype, such as creature, legendary or Dragon.

notes.quote: Put a phrase containing spaces inside double quotes.

keyword.description: Look for a keyword ability, such as flying, trample or first strike.

notes.abilityName: Use an ability name here, rather than a sentence from the rules text.

colors.description: Filter by the card’s colors using the five Magic color letters.

notes.letters: W = white, U = blue, B = black, R = red, G = green. Use C alone for colorless.
notes.format: G,B and GB are equivalent. Lowercase letters are accepted. For spaces, quote the value: /color="G, B".
notes.combine: Use /color=G,B for both colors; repeat /color=G /color=B for either color. Do not combine C with another color.

color_identity.description: Filter by color identity, which can include colors beyond the card’s own color, such as those in its rules text.

notes.notation: Uses the same W, U, B, R, G and C notation as colors.
notes.combine: Combine letters in one value for both colors, or repeat the command for alternatives.

legality.description: Specify a format, optionally followed by a legality status after a colon.

notes.default: A format without a status means legal: /legality=commander and /legality=commander:legal are equivalent.
notes.statuses: Supported statuses: legal, not_legal, restricted and banned. Keep the underscore in not_legal.
notes.formats: Use a format identifier such as standard, modern, pioneer, legacy, vintage or commander. These examples specify filters, not the legality of a particular card.

rarity.description: Filter by printing rarity. Use one of the supported values listed below.

notes.mythic: Use mythic for mythic rare. Repeat the command to supply more than one rarity.

set.description: Find printings from a set by its name or code.

collection.description: Match a set name, set code or an exact collector number.

notes.printings: This command searches printing information; it does not refer to cards you own.
notes.multipleSets: A collector number can occur in more than one set. Add /set= to specify a set as well.

cmc.description: Filter by mana value, also called converted mana cost or CMC.

notes.number: Use a nonnegative number and a period for decimals.
notes.operators: Comparison operators and ranges are not accepted here. Use /cmc=3, not /cmc=>3 or /cmc=2-4.

layout.description: Filter by the card’s layout, such as a normal card or a transforming card.

notes.identifier: Use the layout identifier as the value.

power.description: Filter by the printed power value.

notes.asterisk: The asterisk is a characteristic value, as printed on some cards; it is not a wildcard for any power.

toughness.description: Filter by the printed toughness value.

notes.combine: Combine /power= and /toughness= to specify both characteristics.

loyalty.description: Filter by the printed starting loyalty value of a planeswalker.

notes.symbol: Enter the value shown on the card, including a symbolic value such as X when applicable.
